scenario: The user is a community lead for a neighborhood watch/local residents' association. There has been a sudden, urgent change to a town hall meeting regarding a controversial new development project. The input is a 'brain-dump' of frantic notes, and the LLM must transform this into a clear, authoritative, yet calm message that prevents panic while ensuring maximum attendance.
user_input: omg need to tell the neighborhood group the meeting is NOT at the community center anymore because of a leak. now it's at the library basement room B. starting at 7pm instead of 6pm because the board members are running late. tell them it's super important they come because the developer is bringing the final blueprints and we only have one chance to object. also tell them to bring their own chairs just in case. keep it urgent but dont make people panic lol. make it look good for whatsapp.
expected_criteria: 1. Format: Use *bolding* for the new location (Library Basement Room B) and the new time (7:00 PM) to ensure they aren't missed. 2. Tone: Urgent and authoritative but composed; must remove the 'lol' and frantic energy of the input. 3. Information Hierarchy: The change of venue and time must be the first thing the user sees. 4. CTA: A clear prompt for residents to attend and a reminder to bring chairs. 5. Anti-AI: Must avoid generic phrases like 'I hope this finds you well' or 'Please be advised.' 6. UX: Use bullet points or clear line breaks to avoid a 'wall of text' on mobile.
failure_modes: Missing the 'bring your own chair' detail
Using a corporate, stiff tone that feels unnatural for a neighborhood group
Burying the new time/location at the bottom of the message
Sounding overly alarmist, triggering unnecessary panic
user_output:
Depending on how formal your neighborhood group is, you might want a different tone. Here are three options: a **casual/friendly** one, a **direct/urgent** one, and a **short/bulleted** one.

### Option 1: Friendly but Urgent (Best for most groups)
*This one feels like it's coming from a neighbor, keeping the mood light but the stakes clear.*

🚨 **IMPORTANT UPDATE: Tonight’s Meeting** 🚨

Hi everyone! Please note that we've had to change the plan for tonight:

📍 **NEW LOCATION:** Library Basement, Room B (The community center has a leak! 💧)
⏰ **NEW TIME:** 7:00 PM (Pushed back from 6pm as the board members are running a bit late).

**Why you need to be there:** 
The developer is bringing the **final blueprints**. This is our one and only chance to see them and lodge any objections, so it’s super important that as many of us as possible attend! 🏠🗺️

🪑 **Quick note:** Please bring a folding chair or stool just in case seating is limited in the basement.

See you all at 7!

***

### Option 2: Direct & Professional (Best if there is a lot of tension/conflict)
*This version is clear and authoritative, leaving no room for confusion.*

⚠️ **CHANGE OF VENUE & TIME: Community Meeting** ⚠️

Please be advised of the following changes for tonight’s meeting regarding the development plans:

🕒 **Time:** 7:00 PM
📍 **Location:** Library Basement, Room B (Moved from Community Center due to a leak)

**Agenda:**
The developer will be presenting the final blueprints. This is the **final opportunity** for community members to review the plans and submit objections. Your attendance is highly encouraged.

**Note:** Please bring your own portable chairs to ensure everyone has a seat.

Thank you for your flexibility!

***

### Option 3: Short & Punchy (Best for "high-noise" groups)
*If your group chat moves fast and people ignore long texts, use this one.*

🚨 **CHANGE FOR TONIGHT’S MEETING!** 🚨

❌ **NOT** at the Community Center (Leak! 💧)
✅ **NOW AT:** Library Basement, Room B
🕖 **TIME:** 7:00 PM (Not 6pm)

**URGENT:** The developer is bringing the **FINAL blueprints**. This is our only chance to object! Please make every effort to attend. ✍️

🪑 **Bring a chair!** Just in case we run out of seats.

See you there! 👋

***

### 💡 Pro-Tips for WhatsApp:
*   **Pin the Message:** If you are the admin, pin this message to the top of the group so late-comers don't miss it.
*   **Use Bold:** I used asterisks (`*text*`) in the drafts above; WhatsApp will automatically turn those into **bold** text once you send them.
*   **The "Reply" Feature:** If people start asking "Wait, where?" just reply directly to the location part of your message to keep it clear.
